clauses.clause: Zero console errors over a full real-input play-through of the level.
clauses.note: All20 level/quality cells complete by physical keyboard/mouse with zero console/page errors and zero objective skips; source and console observer hashes match. L10 low/high each use validated contiguous actual production Resume saves. High L9 uses the explicitly identified existing countryside route after the original road driver orbited; original incomplete trials remain archived. Protected player mode measures console stability, not mortal combat balance.
